content: <thought>To locate the template that reproduces the Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons (HWE) transformation, I will search the template catalog using functional groups that are formed in the forward reaction. The HWE reaction creates a carbon‑carbon double bond (C‑C double bond) and an aliphatic carboxylic acid. Providing these as functional_groups_formed should return the relevant template, including its ID. Once the template is identified, I can return its ID together with the mapped reaction SMILES (mapped_rxn).
